ference/oauth/import-oauth-tokens.md): **Deprecated.** Use `PUT /projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/accounts/{account}`. This
route uploads to your default account on the server, creating an unnamed one when the server has none, and is removed 90 days aft
er the accounts API shipped. Every answer carries `Deprecation: true`, a `Sunse…\n- [Create a project](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api
-reference/projects/create-a-project.md): Creates a project in the caller's organization and responds `201` with its detail. Requi
res organization membership and counts against the plan's `maxProjects` limit. Guest callers are denied.\n- [Delete a project and

IBLE, and it cascades: project access grants and invites, the mapped workspace and its memberships, every saved server in the proj
ect (each soft-deleted asynchronously, which also rotates the host configs that referenced it), and hosted tasks. Requires project

ata.md): Updates name, description, icon or visibility. Requires project admin; a non-member gets `404` rather than `403`, so the
response never confirms that a project exists. The project's server map is not updatable here. See the per-server routes.\n- [What
the caller may do here](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/projects/what-the-caller-may-do-here.md): Role, gate state, plan li
mits and a set of derived booleans, so an agent on a static surface can check before it acts instead of attempting a write and rea
ding the failure.\n- [Save a server into a project](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/save-a-server-into-a-project.md)
: Creates a saved MCP server and responds `201` with its detail. This is the provisioning entry point: every eval, host and enviro
nment route addresses servers that were created here. Names are unique per workspace, so a clash responds `409` rather than silent
ly returning the existing row. Secret-bear…\n- [List a server's revisions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/list-a-se
rvers-revisions.md): A saved server's stored revisions, newest first. A revision is a capture of the server's tools and server inf
o, recorded whenever they change on a connect, an eval run or a chat session. Reads stored data and never connects to the server,
so it works for stdio servers too. A server the caller cannot…\n- [Get one server revision](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/
servers/get-one-server-revision.md): One stored revision: every tool's definition and the server info the server reported. `droppe
dFields` lists paths storage dropped for size; their values are unknown, not absent.\n- [Diff two server revisions](https://docs.m
cpjam.com/api-reference/servers/diff-two-server-revisions.md): Compares `from` (default: the revision before) with `revisionNumber
`: tools added and removed with their definitions, tools changed with the fields that moved and both definitions, and each changed
server info field with both values. Revision 1 has nothing before it, so diffing it needs `from`. A fi…\n- [Get one saved server]
(https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/get-one-saved-server.md): The server's detail, projected toward the hosted shape. S
ecrets are never included: `hasClientSecret` reports presence only. A server id from another project reads as `404`.\n- [Delete a

ascade: MCP Apps views, hosted OAuth credentials, encrypted secret objects, and a rotation of every host config that referenced it

e unchanged. Renaming re-checks per-workspace uniqueness (`409` on a clash). Editing a server shared as an OAuth connection requir
es project admin. `clientSecret` and `clearClientSecret` are mutually exclusive.\n- [List a project's server groups](https://docs.
mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/list-a-projects-server-groups.md): A server group is an immutable snapshot of a set of saved
servers. Pinning one on an environment is what keeps a run off its host's live server list, so a composed run keeps testing the s
ervers it was composed against even after the shared host is edited.\n- [Snapshot servers into a server group](https://docs.mcpjam
.com/api-reference/environments/snapshot-servers-into-a-server-group.md): Creates a server group holding exactly the given servers
and responds `201` with its detail. Groups are create-only: there is no update route, because an editable group would reintroduce
the drift that pinning exists to prevent. Names are unique per project, so a clash responds `409`. Servers must b…\n- [List a pro
ject's environments](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/list-a-projects-environments.md): The project environments
saved in the project. Archived environments are excluded unless `includeArchived=true`: you need that to find one to restore.\n-
[Check what this deployment's environment surface supports](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/check-what-this-dep
loyments-environment-surface-supports.md): Report which environment features this MCPJam deployment accepts. Call it before sendin
g a model override: clients ship independently of the platform, and a field an older deployment does not know is a hard validation
error there rather than a silently ignored one. A deployment too old to answer rep…\n- [Show one environment](https://docs.mcpjam

dRevision` when writing to it.\n- [Preview what an environment resolves to](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/pre
view-what-an-environment-resolves-to.md): Resolve an environment to the exact execution inputs a run would use right now: the host
's current config and the closed server set. Returns 409 when the environment cannot currently produce a runnable configuration; `
details.code` carries the specific reason (`ENV_NO_SERVERS`, `ENV_HOST_MISSING`, ……\n- [Get or create an unnamed environment for a

GET-OR-CREATE an UNNAMED, content-addressed environment for a composed stack: a host plus an optional server group and model over
ride. The environment does not appear in the project's list of named environments.\n- [Archive an environment](https://docs.mcpjam
.com/api-reference/environments/archive-an-environment.md): Archive an environment. It stops being selectable for runs and frees i
ts name for a new one, but the row is kept and can be restored: this is why archive is a sub-action rather than a DELETE. Requires
`expectedRevision`: the revision you last read. If the environment changed since, the write is reje…\n- [List a project's scenari
os](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-a-projects-scenarios.md): The studies published from this project: name, ac
cess mode, attached servers, and share link. Read-only.\n- [Publish an environment for user testing](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-r
eference/studies/publish-an-environment-for-user-testing.md): PUT, not POST, because publishing is IDEMPOTENT: one study per envir
onment, and publishing an already-published environment returns the existing one rather than minting a second. `created` says whic
h happened.\n- [Unpublish an environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/unpublish-an-environment.md): Takes the st
udy down. Unpublishing does not require User Testing access, so an organization that loses access can still take a live study down
